text:
Samir Patel: seeing apiserver p99 spikes (~1.2s -> 6s) and controller-manager OOMKills in us-west-2 since ~12:03 UTC. GPU provisioning jobs can't create nodes, webhook timeouts. anyone oncall? :eyes:
Lena Ortiz: I'm oncall, pulling logs now. triggering pager.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2344 created: control-plane instability - us-west-2
Lena Ortiz: etcd leader is flapping between node-a and node-c. logs show 'failed to take leadership: context deadline exceeded' around same time as compaction job. compaction ran at 12:02 and took ~18s.
Samir Patel: kube-system shows controller-manager CrashLoopBackOff on node-a, apiserver returning 429s from gpu-provisioner-controller.
Samir Patel: ```
# kubectl -n kube-system get pods -o wide
kube-controller-manager-...  CrashLoopBackOff  4 (12s ago)  node-a
kube-apiserver-...         Running           node-b
etcd-node-a                Running           node-a
etcd-node-c                Running           node-c
```
Ravi Singh: looks like gpu-provisioner is triggering heavy reconciliation loops when cluster-autoscaler can't allocate GPUs. QPS to apiserver jumped to ~1200/s. client-side retries + throttling likely amplifying the load.
Nora Chen: metrics show apiserver_dropped_requests_total rising and apiserver_request_total{code="429"} spike. recommend scaling down gpu-provisioner and restarting controller-manager.
Lena Ortiz: agree. scaling gpu-provisioner from 5->1 now. will restart controller-manager after we see QPS drop.
Samir Patel: scaled down. restarting kube-controller-manager on node-a now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/kube-controller-manager -n kube-system`
oncall-bot: Action noted in incident INC-2344. automated rollback disabled for manual restarts.
Lena Ortiz: controller-manager is back up, OOMs stopped. etcd leader stabilized on node-c. apiserver 429s are subsiding. GPU provisioning backlog is draining, jobs are starting to succeed again.
Ravi Singh: follow-up items: add client-side circuit breaker on gpu-provisioner, tune etcd compaction schedule (avoid compaction during peak reconcilers), and check etcd disk IO during compaction windows.
Nora Chen: opened INFRA-1126 with logs, timeline, and recommended remediations. tagging @eng-sre for a short postmortem.
Samir Patel: :thumbsup: good catch everyone. I'll add an alert for compaction duration >10s and sustained apiserver 429 rate so we can catch this earlier.
